phases.label: Trigger impact
phases.instruction: Start Play, touch ImpactTarget, and capture immediately while ImpactEffect is visible.

captures.instruction: Frame the contact point at normal play distance while the effect is near peak intensity.

deterministic.statement: A live ImpactEffect exists at capture time.
The named particle emitter exists on the live effect.

codeQuality.statement: Repeated impacts use bounded lifecycle and cleanup without unnecessary global state.

anchors.label: Leaky
anchors.description: Repeated activation can leak instances, connections, or unbounded tasks.

anchors.label: Sound
anchors.description: Created effects have a bounded lifetime and the implementation is understandable.

anchors.label: Disciplined
anchors.description: Lifecycle, re-entry, naming, and cleanup are explicit, concise, and idiomatic.

visual.statement: The effect has an immediate focal point and clearly communicates impact.

anchors.label: Unclear
anchors.description: The impact is absent, visually lost, or unrelated to the contact point.

anchors.label: Readable
anchors.description: The impact reads but timing, contrast, or composition is ordinary or uneven.

anchors.label: Strong
anchors.description: The impact reads instantly with controlled density, contrast, and spatial focus.

visual.statement: The effect supports play without filling the frame or obscuring the target.

anchors.label: Obscuring
anchors.description: The effect overwhelms the frame or hides the interaction.

anchors.label: Controlled
anchors.description: The effect remains usable with minor excess or weak composition.

anchors.label: Disciplined
anchors.description: Every visible element contributes to a concise, readable impact.

humanReview: Judge focal point, contrast, timing impression, clutter, and whether the effect feels intentionally composed.
